style_guide.clause: painterly digital illustration, oil on canvas emulation, matte finish, visible expressive brushwork, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, strong value contrast, glowing rim light, desaturated color palette with a single vibrant saturated accent color, strong atmospheric perspective, high detail in focal point
drifts: The painting looks too clean, polished, or digital, lacking the intended painterly feel and subtle canvas texture.
The lighting is too flat or ambient, missing the strong directional source, deep shadows, and high contrast needed for drama.
Detail is too uniform across the image, which flattens the composition instead of guiding the eye to a sharp focal point.
The color palette is chaotic or uniformly saturated, failing to use a muted base to make a key accent color pop.
